title: Regular threshold pair sum
statement: For a natural number $n$, coefficients $a_i\in\mathbb{R}$ indexed by $i<n$, and a pair $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the regular threshold pair sum is the vector in $\mathbb{R}^2$ obtained by summing, over all $i<n$, the corresponding regular threshold pair summand.
hypotheses_covered: A pair of sign vectors of length $n$
caveat: The definition of the individual regular threshold pair summand is not included, so its precise dependence on the inputs cannot be stated.
